crystalFormTypes.name: Pentagon-tritetrahedron or tetartoid or tetrahedral pentagon-dodecahedron

pyroelectric.description: Spontaneous electric polarization, which changes with temperature: a polar vector p_i.

ferroaxial.description: Ferroaxial (ferro-rotational) order, e.g. a net rotation of structural units about an axis: an axial vector A_i.
ferroaxial.source: Hlinka, Privratska, Ondrejkovic & Janovec, Phys. Rev. Lett. 116, 177602 (2016); classes: Birss (1966), Tables 4a and 4c, pp. 56–58

piezoelectric.description: Electric polarization linear in stress, P_i = d_ijk T_jk: a polar tensor of rank 3, symmetric in j, k.

gyrotropic.description: Optical activity (optical rotation), G = g_ij α_i α_j: the symmetric part of the axial gyration tensor of rank 2.

ferromagnetic.description: Spontaneous magnetization M_s (ferromagnets, ferrimagnets, weak ferromagnets): an axial vector that changes sign under time reversal.

magnetoelectric.description: Linear magnetoelectric effect, P_i = α_ij H_j: an axial tensor of rank 2 that changes sign under time reversal.

piezomagnetic.description: Magnetization linear in stress, M_i = Λ_ijk T_jk: an axial tensor of rank 3, symmetric in j, k, that changes sign under time reversal.
